Record Class ScalaAnnotationTypeData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.scala.processing.visitor.ScalaAnnotationTypeData
Record Components:
name - The annotation type name
annotations - The annotations declared on the annotation type
members - The annotation members by name
retentionPolicyName - The retention policy enum name, if known
repeatableContainerName - The repeatable container annotation name, if known
javaDefined - Whether the annotation type is a Java annotation, which decides the retention it gets when it declares none
nativeType - The native Scala compiler object
public record ScalaAnnotationTypeData(String name, List<ScalaAnnotationData> annotations, Map<String, ScalaAnnotationMemberData> members, @Nullable String retentionPolicyName, @Nullable String repeatableContainerName, boolean javaDefined, Object nativeType) extends Record
Native Scala compiler data for an annotation type.

      public boolean equals(Object other)
      A declaration is itself: two are equal only when they are the same object. Record equality would compare every member, type and annotation beneath, and core keeps these as keys of a hash map -- so every lookup was hashing the whole model of the class.
